text: Cognitive flexibility, as the capacity to adaptively shift between mental sets, comprises multiple subprocesses, including set-shifting and task-switching, and goes through changes in capacity throughout development. Divergent thinking, a core aspect of human creativity, also goes through substantial development during adolescence, a period marked by rapid refinement of executive functions. Despite their developmental interdependence, the distinct contributions of cognitive flexibility subcomponents to divergent thinking during adolescence remain insufficiently understood.
source_label: Set-shifting and task-switching make differential contributions to divergent thinking in adolescence
